subject: Genetics
title: Exercise Changes Gene Expression
description: A micro-lesson that makes Exercise Changes Gene Expression usable.

hook.text: After one workout, methylation patterns change in over 5,000 sites across your muscle cell genome.

buildup.text: A Swedish study had people exercise one leg for three months, leaving the other sedentary.

discovery.text: Exercise demethylates genes involved in energy metabolism and inflammation.

climax.text: Exercise doesn't change your DNA. It changes which parts of your DNA are active.

punchline.text: Every workout rewrites your gene expression patterns.

quiz.question: What did the one-leg exercise study show?
options: Exercise alters methylation patterns in muscle cells
